name: domsep-pneumatic-cannot-connect-to-hydraulic
source:
PneumaticSupply  SUP(fluid$=Air, P=700000, T=300)
HydraulicTank    TNK(P=0)
connect(SUP.out, TNK.port)

error.message: connect(sup.out, tnk.port): cannot connect a 'gas' line (sup.out) to a 'oil' line (tnk.port). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
